chain.label: Gusty crosswind at SJU requiring Vref wind correction
chain.trigger: winds were 060° magnetic at 17 knots and gusting at 23 knots

chain.label: Crew did not correct Vref for wind
chain.trigger: the flight crewmembers did not account for winds when calculating the Vref, and, as a result, they were not in compliance with Executive Airlines' approach airspeed procedures

caused_by.evidence: the correct Vref for the accident flight would have been 101 KIAS

chain.label: No company bounced-landing recovery guidance or training
chain.trigger: the company did not provide formalized bounced landing recovery techniques to pilots before the accident and that none of the company manuals contained any information about bounced landing recovery

chain.label: Preexisting weld discontinuity in captain's seat sleeve
chain.trigger: weld discontinuities...consistent with a lack of fusion that resulted from molten regions not bonding during the welding process

chain.label: Excess airspeed at threshold caused ballooning and initial skip
chain.trigger: the airplane crossed the runway threshold at an airspeed of about 110 KIAS, which was almost 15 knots more than the Vref set on both pilots' airspeed indicators

caused_by.evidence: 9 knots more than what should have been set

chain.label: Captain's abrupt pitch/power inputs caused two hard bounces
chain.trigger: the captain's actions after the initial touchdown resulted in the airplane bouncing on the runway twice

caused_by.evidence: the airplane touched down on the runway the first time...and then skipped and became airborne
written company guidance on bounced landing recovery techniques would have increased the possibility that the captain could have recovered from the bounced landings

chain.label: Captain failed to execute a go-around after the bounces
chain.trigger: after each bounce of the airplane on the runway, the captain did not make appropriate pitch and power corrections or execute a go-around

caused_by.evidence: the captain's inputs made it less likely that he could recover from the two bounces and safely land the airplane; as a result, he should have executed a go-around
the lack of guidance on bounced landing recovery techniques could contribute to similar landing accidents

chain.label: Third touchdown at excessive descent rate produced severe G-loads
chain.trigger: the left MLG touched down at a descent rate of about 19 to 32 fps...the average vertical load for the left side of the cockpit area was calculated to be about 12 Gs

caused_by.evidence: the airplane touched down a third time...at a bank angle of 7° left wing down

chain.label: Left main landing gear fractured under overload
chain.trigger: the left MLG was fractured circumferentially at its vertical trunnion leg just below the actuator attach point...consistent with overstress separation

caused_by.evidence: the vertical forces on the left MLG exceeded those that the gear was designed to withstand, and these excessive forces resulted in overload failure

chain.label: Captain's cockpit seat weld joints fractured
chain.trigger: the weld that attached the end cap to the sleeve fractured at both welded joints during the accident sequence

caused_by.evidence: the captain cockpit seat failed when it was subjected to vertical loads that exceeded those required for certification
weld discontinuities extended through about 25 percent...and about 40 percent of the cross-sectional area

chain.label: Airplane departed runway and crashed in grass beyond threshold
chain.trigger: the airplane came to a complete stop on a grassy area about 217 feet left of the runway 8 centerline and about 4,317 feet beyond the runway threshold

caused_by.evidence: the airplane touched down a fourth time...and it was banked 29° left wing down
his subsequent failure to execute a go-around

chain.label: Captain seriously injured; others sustained minor injuries
chain.trigger: The captain was seriously injured; the first officer, 2 flight attendants, and 16 of the 22 passengers received minor injuries

caused_by.evidence: he sustained a compression fracture of the first lumbar vertebrae
